what: 13.4 classifier fallback chain - feasibility on the data that survived the rebuild

value_it_would_add.claim: the NB router is confidently WRONG on wireframe pages, and this rung is right

why_it_is_not_wired.no_state_machine_class: the rung has no state_machine class; on 8 golden fa_bresler pages it predicts wireframe 6/8, flowchart 2/8, mean confidence 0.8236, max 0.9978 - so no threshold separates it, and wiring it would trade the router's correct 48/48 state machines for a wireframe label nothing downstream can consume
why_it_is_not_wired.cannot_add_the_class_honestly: fa_bresler's raw data is 300 inkml stroke files, not photographs; its PNGs are rendered from strokes while every row in the table is a photograph or scan, so a 3-class model would separate rendering domain rather than diagram type - and the 2-class model already groups rendered fa_bresler with clean sketch2code line drawings, which is that confound showing up directly
why_it_is_not_wired.upper_rungs_blocked_too: the embedding (CLIP) and CNN rungs sit on the same two-class data; the synthetic corpus that covered all five types evenly is 0 rows after the rebuild

what_is_built_and_demonstrated.ocr_to_placeholder: 3 rungs, each verified to still produce code that passes 12.3.1: OCR text (q0/q1/q2) -> node id (s14/s15/s16) -> literal placeholder from _ident(fallback)
what_is_built_and_demonstrated.model_to_emitter: src/pipeline/generate.py emit(): served adapter, else 12.1.6's emitter, marked degraded=True
